newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended steady at 41.30 rupees to the dollar on Wednesday as dollar supply outpaced demand and dealers said the rupee would remain steady in the near term.
"Local players are faced with a liquidity crunch and supply of the dollar remained higher than demand," a dealer said.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on Oct 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 4.40 percent from previous close at 3.20 percent.
